scope: Future semantic acceptance fixtures. No case records an executed Elixir oracle.
source_domain: Each case's files define its isolated source snapshot unless the case explicitly declares multiple roots.

anchor_schema.anchor: Unique literal marker on the same line as selectionText.
anchor_schema.occurrence: One-based occurrence of selectionText before the anchor.
anchor_schema.coordinates: Zero-based LSP positions, derived from the source bytes and negotiated encoding.
